{{Quote|I speak in his name! The Lord of Heart and Eye!|Prophet of Vodal Kressh|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] known only as the '''Prophet of Vodal Kressh''' led the army of [[Vodal Kressh]]'s [[Tomb Dwellers|followers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a strike team sent to [[Mission to Athiss|investigate]] the ruins on the planet. He was particularly strong in [[The Force/Legends|Force]] and was capable of the rare Force ability of [[Pyrokinesis]].
